location_note: Coin report; no map reference. Placed by the title name Jerusalem (Qidron Valley) (Z4).
notes: 18 coins (16 identified) from the excavation of two burial caves (Zissu and Adawi, 'Atiqot 78, not in this reader's units); Nos. 9-12 come from Burial Cave II (troughs, entrance). Burial caves coded as the coins' context (choice C2). Three 1st-c. CE prefect and procurator coins (L100, L101, L103) are not tied by the author to the caves' use.
